question: What division of the eight octads is sought to be fully known?
premises: The subject is the division of eight octads
Full knowledge of it is desired
The knowing is sought in an endless or complete manner
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and completely the division of the eight octads
uncertainties: anantathā may mean 'endlessly' or 'in infinite detail'
plain_english: And I wish to know fully and completely the division of the eight octads.
